create_SPD_manifold: create an SPD manifold instance with configurable Riemannian metric and exponential map options
vectorize_symmetric_matrix: vectorize a symmetric matrix into a compact n(n+1)/2 length vector representation
compute_geodesic_SPD: compute the Riemannian geodesic between two SPD matrices at parameter t
compute_logprob_SPD: compute the base log probability of SPD manifold points under a Gaussian prior
project_SPD_matrix: project a matrix onto the SPD manifold by clamping eigenvalues to be non-negative
